snippet.title: Resident Evil Survival Unit Official Announcement – Multi-language Subtitles
snippet.description:
A New Survival Horror Strategy Game―

The Official Announcement for Resident Evil Survival Unit, a new mobile strategy game.

🛒 Pre-register now: https://resu.onelink.me/Rrll/cx9x16tm

■ Date & Time  
Official Announcement (Online): July 10 (Thurs) at 3:00 PM (PDT), 10:00 PM (UTC)

■ Official Links  
Website: https://www.residentevil-survivalunit.com  
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ResidentEvil-SurvivalUnit?sub_confirmation=1
X: https://x.com/RE_SU_EN
Discord: https://discord.gg/resu

Subtitles are available in multiple languages. Please turn on subtitles and select your preferred language from the settings.
